name: Empirical Bayes generalized linear model (EBGLM)
model_likelihood: Canonical exponential-family GLM with eta_i=x_i^T beta; known dispersion
prior: Independent identically distributed effects from chosen g in G; supported ash option has fixed variance grid and learned mixture weights
inference_algorithm: Mean-field VI with second-order likelihood expansion; optimize posterior means and prior parameters via L-BFGS-B; inverse normal means via bisection
estimand: Approximate coefficient posterior means for prediction; estimated prior
tunable_settings: Prior family; ash K and variance grid; optimizer memory m=10 in experiments

name: Bayesian normal mean (BNM)
prior: Supplied prior g on scalar effect b
inference_algorithm: Compute normal-means marginal likelihood and derivative; EBGLM inverse problem uses the specified posterior mean
estimand: Scalar posterior mean and posterior distribution
data_input: Scalar observation z, variance s^2 and prior g; EBGLM uses an inverse pseudo-observation
